'''2007 New York State Championship Joe Young LS An Unusual Amount Of Fear''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Young]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Joseph Young
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
